goal: A customer buying 100.00 with a 10 percent coupon is charged 81.00 instead of 90.00 by Invoice.checkout. Fix the calculation. The invoice contract is subtotal of price times quantity, one percentage discount, then percentage tax, and ROUND_HALF_UP to cents only on the final payable amount. Coupon percentages outside 0..100 raise ValueError. Keep the checkout API and Decimal return type.
